message.content:
In a standard Texas Hold’em game the most hearts a single player can hold is **seven** (five community cards + two hole cards).  
The player who actually has the most hearts will be the one with a **flush** (five hearts) – or, if you’re looking at all seven cards, the one whose seven‑card hand contains the most hearts.

If you want a concrete example or a simulation to see who ends up with the most hearts in a particular deal, just let me know and I can run a quick deal for you.
